adhkar.arabic_text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
adhkar.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillah wal hamdu lillah
adhkar.translation: We have entered the morning and the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, all praise is for Allah

adhkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsaina wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaikan nushur
adhkar.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection

adhkar.arabic_text: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
adhkar.transliteration: Amsaina wa amsal mulku lillah wal hamdu lillah
adhkar.translation: We have entered the evening and the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, all praise is for Allah
In Your name O Allah, I die and I live
Glory be to Allah and praise Him
There is no god but Allah
